entries.german:
1407. 8. März. 0. A0. — Heinrich von Rosenberg und Odolen von Pyssel, Vor münder der Waisen nach Wilhelm von Landstein, verkaufen dem Andreas ron Wlcetin und Heinrich von Wihnanitz das Dorf Driesendorf um 300 Schock Prager Groschen.

My Gindrzich z Rosenberka a Odolen z Pyssel tu dobu purkra- bie na Lypniczy poruczniczy syrolka a dczery nebozstika Wylemo- wye z Landstayna wyzna wame zewnye wssyem tyemto list em, ktoz gey czysti budu nebo cztuczie vslyssye, ze sme z dobrym rozmyslem a potazem pro welyku potrzebu swrchupsaneho syrotka prodaly wes rzeczenu Strziezow se wssym panstwym, s bruky, s rzeku, s lessy y s podaczym kostela tobo w Strziezowie, y se wssymy vzyttky, czoz ktey wsy slussye, nycz sobye any tomu syrotku na tom prawa nezachowawHgicze, slowutnym panossyem Ondrzeyowy z Wlczetyna tu dobu burgrabi na Crumplowie a Gindrzichowy z Wyhnanicz tu dobu burgrabi na Przibeniczich za trzy sta kop grossuow Prazskych 245 dobrych strziebrnych, ktere gsu nam daly a zaplalyly penyecy hotowymy. Protoz my Gendrzich z Rosenherka a Odolen z Pyssel prwny gystczy a podle uas slowutny panossye Jan rzeczeny Zubek fu dobu purkrabie na Nowembradye z Budyslaw (sicj a Jan z Krasselowa tu dobu purkrabie na Chusnicze wssyczkny spolu slybu- gem gednu ruku nerozdyelnu dobru nassy wyeru bezewssye Isty, to naprzed gmenowane zbozie zprawyty przed kazdym czlowyekem duchownym nebo swyetskym przcdewssemy syrotky y przedewssemi wyeny, yakoz Czeska¡ zemye za prawo ma. К tomn slybugem tez gednu ruku dobru wyeru, yakzto sye drzewe rzeklo, to wsseczko zbozie naprzed rzeczene w zemske dczky wlozyty rzeczenym pano- ssyem Ondrzeyawya Gindrzichowy na prwnye suchedny, paklybiehme tu bezelsty nemohly, ale y lmed na druhe suchedny, potom pakli- bichme opyet tu bezelsty nemohly, ale konecznye na trzelye suchedny, gesto przedw;moczy nayblyss budu, a to wsseczko y sprawyty, y wedczky wolozyty slybugem vczinily, y dluzny sme gym Ondrzeyawy y Gindrzichowy swrchupsanym tyem wssyem rza- dem, yakzto tato zemye Czeska za prawo gma. Paklybichom toho nevczinily, to czyssany sprawyly, any wedczky wlozyly, tehdy hned rzeczenym Ondrzeyowy a Gindrzichowy, nebo ktoz by tento lyst gmyel s gych dobru woly, a nas vpomenul, mame y dluzny sme na swobodnych dyedynach zstupyty trzetynu weysse a to take spra wyty y wedczky wlozyty, yakoz swrchupsano stogy. Paklybiehme toho wsseho nevczinily, gehoz buoh neday, tehdy hned ku vpo- menuty naprzed rzeczenych panossy Ondrzege a Gindrzicha, neb toho, ktoz by tento lyst ymyel, zadny druheho neczekage any sye druhym wymluwage, ale dwa z nas sprawczy samy, nebo myesto sebedobre panossye rzadu rytyerzskeho, kazdy s gyednym pacholkem a se dwyema konmy mame gety do myesta Trzebonye do hospody cztneho hospodarze, kteruss nam tu vkazy samy, nebo swym poslem, a tu mame lezety obyczeynym lezenym, yakzto w Czechach prawo gest, a odtud nazadne prawa newygety, gelyz prwe drzewerzeczene zbozie zprawyme y wedczky wlozyme. Pakly toho obeho nemozem vczinity, ale hotowe penyeze drzewe gmenowane trzy sta kop gro- ssuow a trzetynu wysse hotowymy penyezy zaplatyme, tak aby zadny z nas swu stranu dada ostatku platyty nebyl prazden, a czozby sskod wzely drzewerzeczny Ondrzey a Gindrzich pro nassye obmesskanye gezdyecze nebo posly ssyelycze, nebo kterak kolywiek naklady 246 ezinyecze, gestoby dobrym swyedomym vkazafy mohly, drzewerze- czeneho lezenye nemame prazdny byti, gelyzto wsseczko zaplatyme. A ktozby s nas prawczy naprzed rzeczenych prwe vmrzel, nezly sye to wsseczko naprzed rzeczene dokona, tehdy my zostaly zywy sly- bugem pod pokutu tehoz lezenye, yakoz naprzed psano stogy, ku vpomenuty drzewe rzeczenych panossy Ondrzege a Gindrzicha w nayblyssym myessyeczy tak dobreho a tak mowiteho podle nas przi- stawyty, aby y snamy slybyl za wsseczky vmluwy w tomuto lyslye psane, a lyst nowy vczinity tymyss vmluwamy yakzto tento vplnye bez promyeny. A ktozby z nas naprzed rzeczenych proty tomuto lystu slowem, nebo skutkem sye protywil, to bud proty geho wyerze y proty geho czty, ale k sskodye lystu tohoto zadne. A ktoz by tento lyst gmyel s dobru woly naprzed rzeczenych Ondrzeyowu a Gindrzichowu, ten gma y myety bude plnu mocz wssech tyechto wyeczy w tomuto lystu psanich, yakzto ony samy. Tomu wssemu na pewnost y na potwrzenye peczety nassye wlastnye z dobrym nassyem wyedyenym ktomuto sme lystu prziwyessyly. Genz gest dan leta od narozenye syna bozieho tyssiczeho cztyrzisteho sedmeho, ten vtery przed swatym Rzehorzem. Vier kleine, an Pergamentstreifen hängende Siegel, a in rothem, die übrigen in schwarzem Wachs. n) Das Siegel Heinrich's von Rosenberg bekannt. h) Ein Schild mit einem Ziegenbock oder Widder. — i- S. Odolen i D. Pysel. c) Ein Schild mit einer hufeisenförmigen Zeichnung. — •j- S. Jo- hannis. De. entries.english:
8 March 1407. Heinrich von Rosenberg and Odolen von Pyssel, guardians of the orphans, the son and daughter, of the late Wilhelm von Landstein, sell the village of Driesendorf to Andreas von Wlcetin and Heinrich von Wihnanitz for 300 score Prague groschen.

We, Heinrich von Rosenberg and Odolen von Pyssel, at this time burgraves at Lipnice and guardians of the orphans, son and daughter, of the late Wilhelm von Landstein, declare before all who shall read or hear this letter that, after due deliberation and because of the great need of the aforesaid orphans, we have sold the aforesaid village of Strziezow, with all its lordship, groves, river, woods, the patronage of the church there, and everything belonging to the village, reserving no right therein either for ourselves or for the orphans, to the worthy lords Ondrzey of Wlczetin, at this time burgrave at Crumplow, and Gindrzich of Wyhnanitz, at this time burgrave at Przibenitz, for three hundred score good Prague silver groschen, which they have paid us in ready money. Therefore we, Heinrich of Rosenberg and Odolen of Pyssel, as the principals, and with us the worthy lords Jan called Zubek, at this time burgrave at Nowembradye of Budyslaw, and Jan of Krasselowa, at this time burgrave at Chusnice, all jointly and indivisibly pledge our good faith, without any deceit, to warrant the aforesaid property before every cleric and layperson, before all orphans and before all courts, as the law of the Kingdom of Bohemia requires.

We further jointly pledge our good faith, as stated above, to enter all the aforesaid property in the land registers for the aforesaid lords Ondrzey and Gindrzich on the first court day; if we cannot do so then, on the second court day; and if again prevented, finally on the third court day, whichever is nearest at hand. We are bound to do all this and make the entries as the law of the Kingdom of Bohemia requires. If we fail to do this, to warrant the property and to enter it in the registers, then immediately, upon being summoned by the aforesaid Ondrzey and Gindrzich or whoever holds this letter with their good will, we must warrant it and enter it in the registers from our free hereditary estates. If, God forbid, we fail in all these obligations, then immediately upon being summoned by the aforesaid Ondrzey and Gindrzich or the holder of this letter, without waiting for one another or pleading excuses, two of us, or in place of one of us a worthy lord of knightly rank with one servant and two horses apiece, shall go to the town of Trzebonye to the reputable innkeeper whom they indicate to us or through their messenger. There we shall remain in the customary lodging obligation, as is the law in Bohemia, and shall not leave until we have first warranted the aforesaid property and entered it in the registers. If we cannot do both these things, we shall instead pay in ready money the aforesaid 300 score groschen and one third more, so that none of us may be released from paying the remainder by having paid his own share. We shall also repay in full all expenses which the aforesaid Ondrzey and Gindrzich can show on good evidence to have incurred because of our delay, whether for travel, messengers, lodging or any other costs; they shall not bear any loss from the aforesaid lodging obligation, for we shall pay all of it. If any of us who pledged to warrant the property dies before all the foregoing has been completed, we survivors pledge, under penalty of the same lodging obligation written above, to provide within the next month, when summoned by the aforesaid Ondrzey and Gindrzich, an equally good and capable person in our place, who shall pledge with us to perform all the terms written in this letter and make a new letter with the same terms, complete and unchanged. Whoever of us acts against this letter, by word or deed, shall act against his own faith and honor, but this shall not invalidate this letter. Whoever holds this letter with the good will of the aforesaid Ondrzey and Gindrzich shall have and hold full authority in all the matters written in this letter as if they themselves held it. In witness and confirmation of all this we have attached our own seals to this letter with our sound judgment. Given in the year of the birth of Christ 1407, on the Tuesday before St Gregory’s Day.

Four small seals hang from parchment tags, one in red wax and the others in black. a) Heinrich von Rosenberg’s seal, known. b) A shield with a goat or ram; “S. Odolen i D. Pysel.” c) A shield with a horseshoe-shaped device; “S. Johannis de Budiclaw.” d) A helmet with a horse’s forepart as its crest, the field filled with bees; “S. Johannis de Kraselow.”
